comment: Example data config for finetune.py. Copy it outside the repository, check every licence on the source's own page on the day you train, and fill the folders. kind 'open-folder' = a published dataset downloaded to a folder, kind 'consented-folder' = SIAPSO recordings (needs a consent reference SIAPSO-CONSENT-YYYY-NNNN and a CNERS reference CNERS-YYYY-XXXX); both use a Hugging Face audiofolder layout (audio files and a metadata.csv with a file_name column and the text column). A source with a non-commercial or unverified licence is refused; CC-BY-SA needs --allow-share-alike (see README).

sources.name: kallaama-wo
sources.note: Kallaama: OpenSLR says CC BY 4.0, the ACL copy of the paper says CC BY-NC 4.0. Refused until the team has confirmed the licence in writing; then use --allow-source kallaama-wo.
